module_summary: AXI4 empty slave returning bus errors: skid buffers hold AW until WLAST to issue one B response, and a beat counter generates error read bursts of ARLEN+1 beats.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Write address valid into AW skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: AW skid buffer ready back to master.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWID
anchors.why: Write transaction ID buffered and echoed on BID.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Write data valid into W skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: W skid buffer ready back to master.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WLAST
anchors.why: Last write beat marker, only payload of W skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid set when burst completes, cleared on BREADY.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BREADY
anchors.why: Write response ready clearing bvalid and allowing next burst.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BID
anchors.why: Write response ID from captured AW ID.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BRESP
anchors.why: Constant interconnect error write response.

anchors.name: m_awready
anchors.why: Accepts AW and last W beat together; sets bvalid and captures bid.

anchors.name: m_wready
anchors.why: Drains non-last write beats; last beat waits for m_awready.

anchors.name: m_awvalid
anchors.why: Buffered write address valid from AW skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_wlast
anchors.why: Buffered WLAST gating write address acceptance.

anchors.name: axi_bid
anchors.why: Holds AW ID for the pending B response.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Read address valid starting an error read burst.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Read address ready, low while a read burst is outstanding.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARID
anchors.why: Read transaction ID captured for RID.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARLEN
anchors.why: Burst length loading the read beat counter and first rlast.

anchors.name: axi_rlen
anchors.why: Remaining read beats; drives rvalid, rlast and arready.

anchors.name: rid
anchors.why: Holds ARID for subsequent beats of the read burst.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read data valid while beats remain in burst.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RREADY
anchors.why: Read data ready decrementing the beat counter.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RLAST
anchors.why: Last read beat marker computed from beat counter.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RID
anchors.why: Read response ID from registered axi_rid.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Constant zero read data.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RRESP
anchors.why: Constant interconnect error read response.

groups.name: Write skid buffers
groups.description: AW and W skid buffers holding address until last write beat arrives.

groups.name: Write response
groups.description: Accepts burst on WLAST and returns an error B response with captured ID.

groups.name: Read burst counter
groups.description: Loads ARLEN+1 beats, counts down on RREADY, gates arready.

groups.name: Read data return
groups.description: Registered rvalid, rlast and rid with constant zero data and error response.
